title: viola primulifolia var. acuta
intro: Viola primulifolia var. acuta, commonly known as Chinese violet, is a species of flowering plant in the viola genus. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, fever, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Viola primulifolia var. acuta include its ability to cool and clear heat, calm the mind and body, and promote digestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
